facts.fact: Universal Ads' first-party measurement uses attribution windows of 7, 14, and 30 days.
facts.quote: We use clear, consistent attribution windows (7, 14, and 30 days)

facts.fact: The Universal Ads Pixel tracks up to 18 full-funnel actions across an owned website.
facts.quote: it tracks up to 18 full-funnel actions across an owned website

facts.fact: Universal Ads (citing its own Beyond the Scroll report, November 2025) states that ads seen on TV drive 2.2X higher recall than ads seen on social media.
facts.unit: X higher recall vs. social media
facts.quote: ads seen on TV drive 2.2X higher recall than ads seen on social media

facts.fact: Universal Ads (citing its own Beyond the Scroll report, November 2025) states that ads seen on TV drive 12.4X higher recall than search ads.
facts.unit: X higher recall vs. search ads
facts.quote: and 12.4X higher recall than search ads

facts.fact: Universal Ads states that adding TV to a social campaign drives a +24% increase in purchase intent.
facts.quote: adding TV to a social campaign drives a +24% increase in purchase intent

facts.fact: In the Universal Ads CPG case study, conversions were measured as unique page views by exposed households using a 30-day lookback window between exposure and conversion.
facts.quote: A 30-day lookback window was applied between the time of exposure and conversion.

facts.fact: The CPG brand campaign period in the Universal Ads case study ran from 2024/12/31 to 2025/01/10.
The CPG brand pre-campaign period in the Universal Ads case study ran from 2024/12/11 to 2024/12/30.
The Action Roofing case study campaign period ran from September 2025 to December 2025.
